name: ThirdDimension
description: Tiny scene-based 3D renderer for 32-bit microcontrollers, in the spirit of Adafruit GFX. Scene, orbit/auto-fit camera, directional lights, OBJ-converted meshes or procedural primitives, painter-sorted Gouraud shading, cel (toon) shading with banded fills and switchable outline ink, feature-line outline rendering with hidden-line removal, and ten switchable 1-bit dither methods. Requires hardware float; not for AVR.
